title: The Voice
summary: A fragmented memoir about voice, recording, silence, and the transformation of living speech into institutional text. What is heard and what is written remain close, but never identical.

reality_weaving.imaginative_transformation: The workplace and closed-institution readings remain simultaneously plausible. Voices, recordings, written summaries, and deliberate blanks create an institution whose rules are heard before they are understood.
reality_weaving.emergent_question: When a voice is recorded and rewritten, what remains of what was actually said?

links.note: The previous chapter's places leave traces; this chapter asks what happens to the voices that pass through them.
The next chapter shifts from recorded speech to the paper that gives speech a formal shape.
